scope: All genre families may adopt their OWN genre-specific musical grammar; this file does not activate or impose Rock patterns on any other genre.

placement.rationale: Resolve what musicians should play after genre/song structure and actual instrument capabilities are known, before emitting individual notes, then convert note gestures into source-specific controls only at performance.

output_schema.shared_groove: typed subdivision, beat accent, anticipation, rests
output_schema.role_instructions: one typed gesture plan per resolved track, distinguishing KICK SNARE HAT TOMS CRASH RIDE BASS HARMONY LEAD
output_schema.validation: trace each role instruction to note events + exact resource + audible source stem

external_reference.access_rule: Do not copy GPL source into Composer or silently activate original genre links; evaluate independent process / MIDI boundary and license obligations first.
